about/about-us.html:
JournoPulse is a blog exploring business, technology, culture and public affairs through explainers, context and source-based perspectives. Its 54 posts span nine categories, with six posts in each.
## What you will find
Posts help readers understand an event, an institution or an idea and find the underlying source material. Some revisit past events; others offer practical explanations or cultural observations. Dates distinguish the original publication from later revisions.
## Our approach
The blog draws on linked documents and attributed publications. Interpretations are separated from established facts, and disputed claims retain their attribution. The JournoPulse byline identifies the blog; it does not claim a named reporter's eyewitness account.
## How this edition was made
The source review and content revision used AI assistance on September 17, 2026. On September 18, the site was repositioned as a blog with its original design preserved. A further content pass improved explanations and practical context, rechecked selected source details and replaced the 54 post images with conceptual illustrations. Historical accounts retain their dated context.
## Contact
For a source question, correction or comment about a post, email editorial@journopulse.com.
editorial-policy/editorial-policy.html:
A useful blog post should explain its subject clearly and give readers a way to check important claims. JournoPulse publishes explainers, background and perspectives across its nine categories.
## Facts, sources and interpretation
Source links support factual statements. Official records establish what an authority recorded or decided; company announcements establish what a company said. Interpretations and opinions should be identifiable as such. An allegation remains attributed even when it appears in a blog post.
## Publication dates and updates
Original publication dates are preserved. Revisions carry a separate date and explanation. Posts about past events should be read in their dated context. The September 17, 2026 source revision and September 21 content and illustration update have separate notes. A new revision date does not make a historical account current.
## Byline and AI assistance
AI assistance was used to prepare this edition. The JournoPulse byline does not imply a named expert's credentials, a human editor's review or an original interview. Readers can inspect the linked sources and suggest a specific correction.
## Commercial content
Company statements retain their attribution. Any paid or affiliate content should be clearly disclosed. This edition provides no subscription checkout.
source-methodology/source-methodology.ht:
Source links appear at the end of every article. The text names the relevant authority, institution or reporting outlet where a claim needs attribution.
## Source types
Primary records include court dockets, regulatory documents, official statistics, organizer announcements and institutional publications. Independent reporting is labeled separately. A company's press release is labeled as its own statement.
## Revision method
This edition was prepared with AI assistance on September 17, 2026. The work removed unsupported quotations, unrelated passages and overstated conclusions; added dated context; and linked the underlying sources. It is a source-based revision, not a claim of independent field reporting.
## Content and illustration update
On September 18, 2026, the site was repositioned as a blog and all 54 selected posts received a further content pass. The illustration set was completed September 21. That pass clarified explanations, added practical reading context and checked selected official source details. It did not re-verify every source link or establish all subsequent developments. Corrections identified in those checks are recorded in the relevant post notes.
## Selection and dates
The six newest available posts in each corrected category were retained according to the supplied publication metadata. Fashion required three new posts to reach six. When original publication dates conflicted with event dates, the discrepancy was explained rather than silently changing the publication history.
## Illustrations
Each of the 54 selected posts has a distinct AI-generated editorial illustration. The same artwork is used in its article, previews and sharing metadata. Captions and alternative text identify the images as illustrations. The scenes are conceptual: they are not photographs, eyewitness records or evidence of an event, a person's appearance or a particular facility. The blog's original logo and interface graphics are retained.
corrections-policy/corrections-policy.ht:
A correction request is most useful when it identifies a post, the disputed statement and the evidence for a change.
## Send a specific request
Email editorial@journopulse.com with the post URL, the relevant sentence and a source or explanation. Avoid sending unnecessary personal information. The site provides an email link rather than storing submissions in a web form.
## Visible changes
Posts revised for this edition include a dated revision note describing the substantive changes. Original publication dates remain visible. No response time or review outcome is guaranteed by this page.
## Right of reply
People and organizations discussed in coverage can use the same editorial address to supply a response or relevant documentation. A response should clearly identify the sender and the matter concerned.
contact/contact.html:
For corrections, source questions or a response to coverage, use the editorial email address below. Include a link to the relevant article and enough detail to identify the issue.
## Editorial email
editorial@journopulse.com
## Before you send
Email opens in your own mail application. This website does not submit a message on your behalf or collect a contact form. Avoid sending passwords, payment details or unnecessary sensitive personal information.
ownership/ownership.html:
The supplied site did not identify a legal owner or named beneficial owners. This edition does not invent those details or assert that unspecified funding arrangements have been verified.
## Disclosure status
Ownership, funding sources and material commercial relationships should be supplied by the publisher. No confirmed ownership register or financial disclosure accompanies the site archive.
## Questions
Ownership and funding questions can be directed to editorial@journopulse.com, the address listed in the original site. Company claims in posts are attributed and do not represent an endorsement by JournoPulse.
privacy/privacy-policy.html:
This edition is a static website. Its search filters article titles and text in your browser. It does not require an account or send search text to an external search service.
## Data handled by the site
The delivered code includes no analytics trackers, advertising scripts, cookies, payment collection or contact-form database. Search terms may appear in the page URL when you use the header search form. Your browser may retain URLs in its history.
## Following the blog
The RSS feed lets readers follow posts in a feed reader. The supplied site does not collect email subscriptions.
## Hosting and external links
The hosting provider may process normal request information such as IP addresses and requested URLs. Hosting settings and provider policies are separate from the files in this edition. Linked source websites apply their own policies.
## Email
If you email JournoPulse, your mail provider and the recipient handle that message. Do not include unnecessary sensitive information. This page describes the delivered code and must be reviewed if tracking, advertising, accounts or other services are added.
terms/terms-and-condition.html:
Blog posts provide general information, explanations and perspectives. Dates and source links help establish the scope of each account; a historical article is not a current emergency notice or personal professional advice.
## Source material
External sources remain responsible for their own publications. A link is provided to support checking the post, not as a guarantee that the external page will remain available or unchanged.
## Images and reuse
Third-party images and source material may be subject to their owners' rights. The presence of an item on the site does not grant permission to reuse it elsewhere.
## Contact and corrections
For questions about the site or a specific factual issue, contact editorial@journopulse.com. These notes describe this edition's use; they do not create a paid service or subscription.
our-team/our-team.html:
The JournoPulse organization byline identifies this blog's source-based posts. It does not represent a named reporter's eyewitness account.
## Contributor information
The supplied material did not provide independently verified staff credentials for these revised posts. No reporter biographies, awards or professional qualifications have been added. This edition was prepared with AI assistance.
## Accountability
Every post includes source links and a revision or publication note. Corrections can be sent to editorial@journopulse.com.
advertising-policy/advertising-policy.ht:
This edition includes no advertising placements, affiliate purchase links or sponsorship checkout. Statements taken from company announcements are attributed as company claims.
## Future commercial content
Any future paid placement should be clearly identified and kept distinguishable from editorial content. Adding advertising services would also require reviewing the privacy information and site code.
## Enquiries
The contact address listed by the original site is editorial@journopulse.com.
right-of-reply/right-of-reply.html:
People and organizations discussed in a post can send a response or relevant documentation to editorial@journopulse.com.
## What to include
Identify the post URL, the statements you are responding to, your relationship to the subject and the facts or documents you want considered. A request does not guarantee publication or a particular outcome.
## Corrections
If the issue is a factual error, include supporting evidence. Posts revised in this edition carry dated notes so readers can understand substantive changes.
legal/legal.html:
For information about using the site, see the Terms and Privacy links in the footer. For a post correction or a response to coverage, use the Contact page.
## Publisher disclosure
Ownership and funding information is described on the Ownership page. This edition does not provide a verified legal-entity identity or invent one.
